title: Command
description: A command row written by the api and executed by the engine (API_SPEC §4, DATA-001; table commands). The engine re-validates every command (API-020). There is no command to loosen limits, change leverage, place arbitrary orders or read secrets.

schema_version.description: Schema version (DATA-010). Breaking changes need a migration and an ADR line.

params.description: Present with value FIXTURE when fixture values of unapproved parameters are in effect (RISK-005, RISK-066 item 3, MI-045). Absent otherwise; the spec names no value for the approved case.

fixture_demo_mode.description: Fixture demo only: the entry authorization mode the user set for this run in fixture_demo_mode (RISK-066 item 4). Absent outside fixture demo.

mono_seq.description: Engine monotonic sequence number for ordering within a process (DATA-003). Optional because records not written by the engine (research, Guardian ingest) have none.

client_uuid.description: Client-supplied UUID; a duplicate returns the original result (API-021). Version not fixed by the spec.

type.description: Command names from API_SPEC §4 (MCP_CLIENT_REGISTER / REVOKE split into two).

payload_json.description: Command payload. Per-type payload schemas are not specified yet. Must never contain a secret, TOTP code or token.

anyOf.description: Time of the TOTP re-authentication when API-013 requires one. The code itself is never stored.

auth_context.description: Authorization context; the session token is never stored here.

status.description: Command status. The spec names no values.
